the_question: can this project's no-weights model reach Claude Opus 5.5 on a public benchmark by growing its rule list?
the_answer_measured: no, and the arithmetic is now explicit

the_experiment.benchmark: ARC-AGI-1 evaluation split, public tasks from github.com/fchollet/ARC-AGI
the_experiment.data_location: canonical/evaluation/arc_agi1_eval_sample (1.5 MB, 200 real tasks, in-repo so the number is reproducible)

measurements.stage: rule list + 5 structural primitives (fill holes, mirror-complete, rays, connect, split-panel)
measurements.note: the new primitives added exactly one task, `connect`
same three tasks; no primitive solves more than ONE task

measurements.stage: MDL program search, depth 2 (625 ordered compositions)
measurements.note: COMPOSITION BUYS NOTHING AND COSTS 170x. Depth 2 == depth 1.

the_decisive_measurement.implication: adding a hand-written rule buys roughly one task and never more. 197 tasks are outside the closure of everything this project can currently express.

why_the_task_population_says_nothing_els.reading: the majority need a structural transformation the DSL cannot express -- symmetry completion, periodicity, ray casting from arbitrary objects, occlusion inference. A bigger flat list does not reach them, which is why depth-2 composition added zero.

what_the_web_says_this_means.pure_symbolic_dsl_published: 1.67/240 on ARC-AGI-2 hidden (Bose 2026) -- the same ceiling this measurement hit
what_the_web_says_this_means.vsa_neurosymbolic_published: 3.0% ARC-AGI-1 eval (Joffe & Eliasmith 2026, Nature) -- about 2x this solver
what_the_web_says_this_means.no_pretraining_neural_published: 20% ARC-AGI-1 eval (CompressARC, arXiv 2512.06104) -- 13x this solver, and it learns on the single puzzle
what_the_web_says_this_means.code_as_hypothesis_published: Tycho (NIMI 2026) writes Python as falsifiable hypotheses and verifies against observations -- architecturally identical to this project's action_intents
what_the_web_says_this_means.opus_5_5_reference: 98.5% ARC-AGI-1 / 93.3% ARC-AGI-2 per this repo's own OPUS55_ABSTRACT_GENERALIZATION record
what_the_web_says_this_means.conclusion: 1.5% is not a failure of effort. It is the measured ceiling of a rule list, and it agrees with the published ceiling of the same strategy.

what_would_actually_move_it: REPRESENTATION, not rules: the published jump from ~1.7% to 20% comes from an objective (MDL) applied to a LEARNED representation, not from a bigger primitive set
PER-TASK SEARCH over a PROGRAM SPACE that composes objects, symmetry and periodicity, with description length as the cost -- CompressARC's formulation

REUSE ACROSS TASKS: this project's own law records are the natural library; the crystallizer already stores verified procedures. The published analogue is corpus-guided library learning (Stitch/LILO), 1000-10000x faster than DreamCoder

stage_two__structure_induction.method: MDL over discovered structure: lattice period, symmetry completion, scale, tile, recolour, constant, sub-grid window, object read-out
stage_two__structure_induction.honest_reading: WORSE than the simpler 25-primitive search (3/200). A richer hypothesis set did not help, because the hypotheses are aimed at the wrong problem shape.

why_they_all_missed.symmetry: not one of the first 80 same-size tasks has a symmetric OUTPUT that its input is half of; the hypothesis is simply not what this benchmark asks
why_they_all_missed.subgrid_window: the 10 tasks whose output is a sub-grid are 1x1 OUTPUTS -- find-the-odd-cell -- not window extractions
why_they_all_missed.recolour: zero tasks are a pure per-cell colour substitution
why_they_all_missed.the_134_same_size_tasks: they need structural inference (symmetry of objects, periodicity of patterns, ray casting, occlusion) that none of these descriptions express

stage_two__structure_induction.probe_correction: an earlier probe reported `symmetry` holding on 34 tasks. It was wrong: the probe caught an UnboundLocalError and counted the failure as a hit. The true count is ZERO. A probe that catches an exception and counts it as a pass is the exact failure mode this project has laws against.

the_arithmetic_now_measured_four_ways: depth-2 composition of all 625 ordered pairs -> 3/200 (+0, at 170x cost)
conclusion: adding hypotheses does not move this number. Four independent attempts, four flat or negative results. The published jump to 20 percent is not a bigger hypothesis set; it is a LEARNED REPRESENTATION with a compression objective, which this project does not yet have.
